segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין בֵּין שַׁבָּת לְיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, אֶלָּא שֶׁזֶּה — זְדוֹנוֹ בִּידֵי אָדָם, וְזֶה — זְדוֹנוֹ בְּכָרֵת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The difference between Shabbat and Yom Kippur» with regard to the labor prohibited on those days «is only that» in «this» case, i.e., Shabbat, «its intentional» desecration is punishable «at the hand of Man,» as he is stoned by a court based on the testimony of witnesses who forewarned the transgressor; «and» in «that» case, i.e., Yom Kippur, «its intentional» desecration is punishable at the hand of God, «with karet.»

moves.summary: Shabbat's punishment is by man, Yom Kippur's by karet

positions.claim: intentional Shabbat violation is punished by the court, Yom Kippur by karet
